content.overview: Two adults walk barefoot through the shallow edge of a palm-lined beach. They hold hands, one leans toward the other, and warm orange-pink low-angle light reflects across the calm water.

evidence.label: People
evidence.detail: Two clearly visible young adults: one man and one woman. No other people are visible in the immediate beach scene.

evidence.label: Man — clothing / appearance
evidence.detail: Dark wavy hair; a light white or very pale-blue long-sleeved button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms; gray-taupe trousers rolled to mid-calf; barefoot. He looks down toward the woman with a soft smile.

evidence.label: Woman — clothing / appearance
evidence.detail: Brown hair pulled back loosely; sleeveless white V-neck ankle-length/maxi dress with a gathered waist; delicate necklace; barefoot. She smiles with her head resting on his shoulder and holds his arm while their hands are joined.

evidence.label: Foreground
evidence.detail: Wet reflective sand, a thin line of white foam, their bare feet partly in very shallow water, and faint footprints or foot impressions behind or around them.

evidence.label: Middle ground
evidence.detail: The shoreline curves away to the left. A line of palms and darker coastal vegetation runs along the beach.

evidence.label: Background
evidence.detail: A calm ocean extends to a flat horizon. The sun sits very low above the water, producing a bright vertical reflection.

evidence.label: Weather / light / time clues
evidence.detail: Gentle waves, a clear horizon and warm golden light are visible. The sun is low above the water; its position alone does not distinguish sunrise from sunset.

evidence.label: Action / body language
evidence.detail: The two adults are side by side with their hands joined. The woman rests her head on the man’s shoulder and holds his arm; he angles his head toward her.

evidence.label: Colors / textures
evidence.detail: White clothing; peach, coral, gold, pale pink, and soft blue sky; gray-beige wet sand; dark palm silhouettes; smooth reflective water.

evidence.label: Composition
evidence.detail: The two adults occupy the left third of the image, while the low sun and open water fill the right.

micro: Both subjects are close enough to show relaxed facial expressions rather than silhouettes. Their joined hands, shoulder contact, and being captured mid-step together create the strongest closeness cues.
Neither person is wearing shoes; rolled trousers and bare feet suit walking at the waterline.
The man appears to look toward the woman; the woman looks downward with a smile rather than toward the camera.

inference.high: Their smiles, close body position, and gentle contact may suggest a warm, pleasant moment.
inference.medium: They may be a romantic couple or partners. Holding hands, the woman resting her head on the man’s shoulder, linked-arm contact, and relaxed smiles all support that reading, but the photograph does not prove the exact relationship.
inference.low: One of them might have said something funny, they may have noticed something amusing, or they may simply be smiling because the walk feels pleasant. The exact reason is outside the frame.

timeline.before: They may have been walking farther up the beach or watching the sun lower toward the horizon.
timeline.now: They are walking barefoot through the shallow water, holding hands and leaning close together.
timeline.next: They may continue along the shoreline, stop to watch the sunset, or leave the beach as daylight fades.

content.guardrail: Visible facts come first. A couple/partner reading may be used as supported inference because of hand-holding, shoulder contact, linked arms, and smiles, but engagement, marriage, honeymoon, anniversary, relationship duration, and exact life history are not established.
content.story: CREATIVE EXTENSION — NOT A VISUAL FACT. Perhaps they chose a quiet evening walk after spending the day near the coast. They may be talking privately, sharing a joke, or simply enjoying the silence while the light fades. None of that history is visible; it is a story built around the real cues in the frame.

grammar.title: Phrasal verbs for describing relationships
grammar.explainer: Use relationship phrasal verbs carefully: get along with, grow close to, and spend time with. The image supports present closeness, but a phrasal verb must not invent relationship history, duration, or legal status that the frame does not show.
examples: They seem to get along well, judging from their relaxed body language.

The image does not show when they grew close or how long they have known each other.

models.A1–A2: Two adults are walking barefoot on a beach in warm low sunlight. They are holding hands and smiling. One person is wearing a white dress, and the other is wearing a light shirt and rolled-up pants. The sea is calm and the sky is orange and pink.
models.B1–B2: Two adults are walking barefoot along the edge of the water while holding hands. One leans toward the other, and both are smiling. Palm trees line the beach, and a low sun casts warm light across the sea. The image shows closeness and positive visible expressions, but it does not prove the exact relationship or time of day.
models.C1–C2: The image places two barefoot adults against an open palm-lined shoreline under warm low-angle light. Their joined hands, close positioning, and smiles create a clear visual pattern of physical closeness, while the low sun and broken reflection across the water establish the coastal atmosphere without proving whether the moment is sunrise or sunset.

speaking.30: Before reading the models, give 4–5 simple sentences: setting + three visible facts + one action. Use one relationship phrasal verb carefully without inventing unshown history.

speaking.90: Speak without reading: overview → key subject details → environment/weather/light → action → atmosphere → one Before/Now/Next link. Finish by separating one visible fact from one inference.

Open water, ripples, horizon and reflective surface form a distinct seascape layer.
